The two JSON files are a free precheck request and response observed on
2026-09-06 at `https://agent-economy.kgninja.dev/validate-request` (service 0.4.3).
The input is synthetic, public test JSON. No wallet, payment, quote, transaction,
or real customer data was used. This fixture checks compatibility, not current
availability or actual settlement. Quote, x402 challenge and paid delivery in
the test harness are schema-based mocks and use ephemeral local signing keys.
